enunciado: A die was rolled 20 times: {3,6,1,6,2,5,6,4,3,6,1,2,6,5,4,6,3,2,6,1}. Count how many times each face came up using an array of counters indexed by value, draw a histogram with '#' and state the mode.
objetivos: Use a data value as an index
pistas: Create an array of 7 counters and use positions 1 to 6.
frequency[value]++ records a roll in a single statement.
The mode is the face with the largest counter.
